serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Hootsuite is an enterprise social media management platform used by governments and agencies to engage with citizens, manage crisis communications, and deliver services and information via social media. By managing all social media activity through a single, secure platform, agencies with large and distributed teams can engage directly with citizens across public and private social channels without compromising control over messaging and access. Hootsuite's real-time social listening capabilities, integrations with compliance partners, and ecosystem of more than 200 connected applications help agencies monitor and measure public sentiment, stay compliant with FOIA and other public records laws, and integrate social media across their organization.
